Color Black Civil Green Sparkle Red (Midwest Pedalfest) Black - $125.00 USD Civil Green - $125.00 USD Sparkle Red (Midwest Pedalfest) - $125.00 USD Quantity Add to Cart     I had no intention of doing more than one no knobs pedals. Its kind of a gimmick right? But an old coworker told me that I should have made a Big Muff with no knobs. I made him one as a joke but it just kind of grew on me. Generally I enjoy my Big Muffs with more knobs rather than less so seemed it up being a fun challenge. It is tuned dark with a lot of gain and the tone control has been tweaked to be more mid-forward. The stock settings are volume and gain fully maxed out with the tone set just north of noon for a bit of treble boost. Just like Trust Yourself there are internal trim pots so you can set it to your perfect settings.
